sources.title: BabyLM 4 at EMNLP 2026
sources.snippet: BabyLM 4 at EMNLP 2026: The tentative workshop schedule is now available. Posters from BabyLM 3 (2025) are available in the BabyLM 3 archive. Summary: BabyLM returns for its 4th year as both a shared task and a workshop at EMNLP 2026.

sources.title: BabyLM-community/babylm-baseline-10m-gpt2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 124M model with the GPT-2 architecture trained with the next token prediction loss for 10 epochs (~100M words), as a naive autoregressive baseline for the Strict-Small track of the 2025 BabyLM challenge.
